1.

To the land of glory again We have seen Thee, Jesus, go; But we on this earth yet As strangers must remain. In faith and hope on the desert path We walk here and await Thee.

2.

And soon Thou wilt return, Our Jesus, back here To fetch all Thy saints; May we then ever watch! No hour, no day now do we know, But constantly may we await Thee.

3.

How blessed to meet Thee then With the saints on high, To go with them into the joy And enjoy the marriage gladness, And with Thee, Lord, eternally to be; In this hope we rejoice!
